dialogues.speaker: Azra
dialogues.text: Let me tell you, Zubayr Theater's Nilou is the best dancer ever.

dialogues.speaker: Azra
dialogues.text: Many may be able to dance beautifully, but Nilou is unique in the way she infuses emotions into her dance.

dialogues.speaker: Azra
dialogues.text: It took me a long time to snap out of such a feeling after watching her performance. It's so...
